description: Re-anchored for the in-flight guard spec change (v0.12.0): spec.md additively documents the third deterministic PULL-exclusion guard (the In-flight guard) — the pure is_in_flight(item, in_flight_issue_refs) predicate and the Pull(in_flight_issue_refs=...) injected-set param that EXCLUDES any candidate whose issue ref has an OPEN loop PR (bounded scope: work-intake CONSUMES the set, adds no gh plumbing; default empty set = no-op). This is legitimate new behaviour (mirrors the loopback/park guard precedents), not re-bloat. This baseline records the post-v0.12.0 doc line counts plus a one-line margin, so the housekeep gate continues as a re-bloat regression guard (current docs must stay STRICTLY smaller than this) while the load-bearing-token + cleanup gates remain intact.
